program_cap_scope: 2026-10-28 user: $100 is the upper limit. Read as the strictest case: the TOTAL of the whole programme, the $34.5 already spent included. If the user meant new spending only, the stop below is just reached later.
hard_stop_reason: The ledger can miss spending (a call that wrote no run record, a summary overwritten). Every run is refused once the ledger total reaches 90% of the cap, so that the true spend stays under the cap; the ledger is reconciled with the providers' consoles at the end of each stage.
reserve_reason: kept for re-runs after a core fix; a stage may not use it
